review_scope: All70 open issue bodies and139 comments across47 threads; byte-equivalent to the fully reconciled November4 requirements, refreshed November7.
closure_policy: Close the repaired issue only when its required acceptance is satisfied; conditional unavailable-target witnesses remain explicitly unexecuted. Do not retire research, performance or real-hardware gates from source-only or synthetic evidence.

issues.title: [P1] Invalidate or roll back bounded outputs after partial GEMM failure; mixed CRT planes currently export successfully
remaining_required_acceptance: Real AMD allocation/copy/launch/status failure, publication and recovery qualification; deterministic host fault hooks do not establish real device failure behavior.

issues.title: [P2] Compute exact-wide admission once and make expensive moment refinement demand-driven
remaining_required_acceptance: Matched gfx1100/gfx942 proof/refinement/setup and complete-route measurements with eager/scalar policy fidelity; do not transfer old speedups to this source.

issues.title: [P1] Qualify full matrix address ranges before selecting 32-bit HIP indexing
remaining_required_acceptance: Resource-budgeted actual large-address correctness and boundary/checksum evidence, plus narrow/wide address ISA, resource and matched-shape timings. Tiny arithmetic helpers do not replace the large-extent run.

issues.title: [P2] Count independent same-environment executions in the performance variance gate
issues.acceptance_evidence: Independent execution cohorts and shared report/ledger/installer custody are implemented; legitimate two-run positive controls and copied/stale/environment/source/reference/receipt negatives pass. The omitted legacy report controls have been restored and qualified.

issues.title: [Research P1] Define proof-carrying arithmetic and instruction contracts for every representation
remaining_required_acceptance: Actual target encoding/instruction execution and source-bound plan-validation overhead/zero per-element symbolic-work evidence beyond scalar certificates and local ordinary exact tests.

issues.title: [Research P1] Add a conversion-aware analytical planner before measured kernel promotion
remaining_required_acceptance: Disjoint held-out planner selection regret, prediction error, planning latency/runs avoided and observed workspace on the declared many-small/skinny/long-K/rectangular/repeated-B/wide cohorts.

issues.title: [Research P1] Calibrate exact-GEMM roofs with instruction, conversion and memory microbenchmarks
remaining_required_acceptance: Hardware-observed instruction/conversion/CRT/memory/system roofs, clocks/resources/counters and independently repeated held-out calibration for each target/compiler/work tuple.

issues.title: [Research P2] Extend offline modulus search into a certified hardware-weighted scheme optimizer

issues.title: [Research P1] Build cost-aware device bound discovery and compact adaptive-prefix schedules
remaining_required_acceptance: Measured discovery/descriptor/summary cost, prefix/tile histograms and net complete-route benefit versus strongest global/fixed/caller-bound controls, including no-benefit fallback overhead.

issues.title: [Research P1] Fuse native conversion and multiple residue channels inside matrix-engine tiles

issues.title: [Research P2] Schedule residue and output tiles for measured XCD/cache locality
remaining_required_acceptance: Actual topology/cache/XCD locality, traffic/counter/resource evidence and strongest-control matched execution timings rather than logical scheduling models.

remaining_required_acceptance: Target hierarchical split-K/Stream-K resource/traffic and complete-route measurements with exact cap/tail boundaries and bounded partial-workspace overhead.
